name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
variation: Alternating incline curl, near arm demonstrated

beats.label: Set
beats.cue: Let the near arm hang beside you.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Keep your upper arm beside the bench.

beats.label: Curl
beats.cue: Curl toward your shoulder; keep wrist straight.

beats.label: Squeeze
beats.cue: Pause without swinging your upper arm.

setup: Lie back on a low incline bench with both feet planted.
Hold one dumbbell in each hand and curl one arm at a time.
The near arm is demonstrated; repeat the same controlled curl on the other side.

advice.tip: Keep the working upper arm beside the bench and lower the dumbbell slowly before changing sides.
commonMistakes: Swinging the upper arm to lift the weight.
Lifting the shoulder away from the bench.

findings: This is an alternating variation: one complete near-arm curl is demonstrated and the setup/cues explicitly say to repeat the opposite side. The far arm holds its weight stationary beside the body; a simultaneous bilateral curl is not claimed.
